results.q: 사건 피의자가 보유한 계좌의 이체 내역
results.cypher: SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (p:vt_psn)-[:suspect_in]->(c:vt_case)<-[:from_account]-(b:vt_bacnt)<-[:to_account]-(t:vt_transfer) RETURN p, c, b, t $$) AS (p agtype, c agtype, b agtype, t agtype);
SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (c:site_cluster { is_phishing:  true})<-[:belongs_to_campaign]-(s:vt_site)<-[:hosts]-(ip:vt_ip) RETURN c, s, ip $$) AS (c agtype, s agtype, ip agtype);
SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (n) WHERE n.source_domain = 'osint' RETURN n $$) AS (n agtype);

SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (c:vt_case)<-[:suspect_in]-(p:vt_psn) RETURN c.flnm AS case, count(p) AS suspects ORDER BY suspects DESC $$) AS (case agtype, suspects agtype);
SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (n) RETURN n.source_domain AS domain, count(n) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC $$) AS (domain agtype, cnt agtype);

SELECT * FROM cypher('tccop_v40_demo', $$ MATCH (c:vt_call) RETURN c, c.duration AS _ord_0 ORDER BY _ord_0 DESC LIMIT 10 $$) AS (c agtype, _ord_0 agtype);
